title: Colors Song for Kids! Learn Colors with Bloop the Jelly Blob
description:
The Colors Song for kids! Sing along with Bloop the jelly blob, who changes color with every word: red, yellow, orange, green, blue and purple.
Kids learn their colors, color mixing (blue + yellow = green) and the rainbow. Ages 2-5.

LYRICS
Red, red, apple red!
Bloop is red, red, red!
Yellow, yellow, sunny sun!
Yellow banana, yum, yum, yum!
Colors, colors, look at me!
I can change, one, two, three!
Red and yellow, green and blue,
Colors, colors, sing with me!
Orange, orange, juicy treat!
Orange carrots, good to eat!
Green, green, froggy green!
Green grass, green leaf, green bean!
Clap, clap! Clap your hands!
Stomp, stomp! Stomp your feet!
Jump, jump! Jump up high!
Spin around and wave hi!
Blue, blue, sky so blue!
Blue, blue, the ocean too!
Purple, purple, grapes for me!
Purple flowers, one, two, three!
Red, orange, yellow, green,
Blue and purple, what a team!
All the colors, look and see,
Make a rainbow, you and me!

title: Yummy Fruits Song for Kids! Eat Your Rainbow with Pipkiko
description:
The Yummy Fruits Song for kids! Sing along with Pipkiko the strawberry and her fruit and veggie friends: apple, banana, carrot and broccoli.
Kids learn fun true food facts, colors of the rainbow and to wash fruits and veggies before eating. Ages 2-6.

LYRICS
Yummy fruits, crunchy veggies, eat your rainbow!
Red and orange, yellow, green, yum yum yum!
Munch munch, crunch crunch, healthy and strong!
I'm Pipkiko, a strawberry, red and sweet!
Tiny seeds on the outside, count them, wow!
About two hundred seeds on every one!
Strawberry, strawberry, yum yum yum!
Crunchy apple, shiny red, crunch crunch crunch!
Drop an apple in the water, look, it floats!
Apples float, they have lots of air inside!
Apple, apple, yum yum yum!
Yellow banana, peel it down, peel peel peel!
Bananas grow in bunches called a hand!
Each banana is a finger, one, two, three!
Banana, banana, yum yum yum!
Orange carrot, long and crunchy, munch munch munch!
Carrots grow down under the ground!
Pull it up, pull it up, here it comes!
Carrot, carrot, yum yum yum!
Clap your hands, clap clap clap!
Stomp your feet, stomp stomp stomp!
Spin around and jump jump jump!
Wave hello to all your friends!
Green broccoli looks like a tiny tree!
The little bumps are flowers you can eat!
Tiny trees, tiny trees, chomp chomp chomp!
Broccoli, broccoli, yum yum yum!

title: The Planets Song for Kids! 8 Planets with Gizmo the Robot
description:
The Planets Song for kids! Sing all 8 planets in order with Gizmo the robot: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.
Kids learn one true fact about each planet and the Sun. Ages 3-7. Blast off and sing along!

LYRICS
Beep boop! Hi, I'm Gizmo!
Let's sing the Planets Song!
Mercury, Mercury, closest to the Sun,
Tiny and speedy, zoom, zoom, zoom!
Venus, Venus, hottest one of all,
Thick clouds hide it, hot, hot, hot!
Earth, Earth, our home sweet home,
Water, plants, and you and me!
Eight planets spinning round the Sun,
Mercury, Venus, Earth and Mars,
Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune,
Eight planets spinning round the Sun!
Mars, Mars, the dusty red one,
Rusty dust makes Mars look red!
Jupiter, Jupiter, biggest of them all,
A giant storm, the Great Red Spot!
Saturn, Saturn, with the shiny rings,
Rings of ice and rock go round!
Clap, clap! Clap your hands!
Spin, spin, like a planet!
Jump, jump, reach the stars!
Three, two, one, blast off!
Uranus, Uranus, spinning on its side,
Tipped way over, rolling like a ball!
Neptune, Neptune, farthest from the Sun,
Deep blue, windy, and so cold!
Eight planets, now you know them all!
Let's all sing it, everyone!
Bye bye! Sing it again tomorrow!
